title: Salesforce Financial Services cloud
description:
**Essential Functions and Responsibilities** 




 • Design, configure, and deliver end\-to\-end solutions using standard Salesforce and FSC capabilities first, including lending data and processes, platform configuration, coexistence with legacy custom records, and phased migration
 



 • Build and support reusable OmniStudio and Experience Cloud experiences using OmniScripts, FlexCards, Data guided workflows, secure external\-user access, and portal troubleshooting.
 



 • Develop and maintain document\-generation and lifecycle solutions using OmniStudio Document Generation and templates, data mappings, assembly, storage, versioning, access, retention, audit trails, and production support.
 



 • Engineer readable, modular, bulk\-safe, and supportable Apex, LWC, Aura, Flow, triggers, REST services, queueables, batches, schedulables, and metadata\-driven automation while managing order of execution, recursion, governor limits, asynchronous processing, record locking, and fault handling and third parties using REST, webhooks, callouts, Named Credentials, OAuth/JWT, retries, idempotency, structured errors, logging, alerting, reconciliation, and documented API contracts.
 



 • Enforce object\-, field\-, and record\-level security across Apex, LWC, Flow, OmniStudio, APIs, and Experience Cloud using appropriate sharing, CRUD/FLS controls, permission sets, encryption, masking, consent, retention, audit, secure logging, and regulated non\-production data practices.
 



 • Create meaningful automated tests and regression coverage using isolated realistic data; reproduce defects and address root causes; validate business outcomes, security, integrations, asynchronous work, documents, portals, and governor limits; and resolve code\-analysis, peer\-review, coverage, and deployment findings.
 



 • Deliver through Jira\-linked Git workflows, pull requests, Salesforce CLI, Metadata API, package manifests, Salesforce Git Delta, and GitHub Actions across Validation, DevBuild, QA, Stage, Production, and hotfix environments, keeping approved org changes synchronized with source and preparing deployment, rollback, and post\-release evidence.
 



 • Investigate and resolve Flow, Apex, callout, async, portal, document, data, locking, and governor\-limit failures; participate in incident response and root\-cause analysis; maintain monitoring and support runbooks; and provide operational ownership during releases, sandbox refreshes, and data migrations.
 



 • Collaborate with the Salesforce Solution Architect, Product Manager, Project Manager, business analysts, QA, administrators, data and integration teams, stakeholders, and vendors to refine and estimate work, surface risks and blockers, participate in reviews and demos, maintain implementation and support documentation, share knowledge, and perform related duties as assigned.
 



  





**Minimum Requirements** 




 The responsibilities listed below are required. Accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions and responsibilities.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 



 • 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience delivering production applications.
 



 • 2\+ years of practical Financial Services Cloud implementation or development experience.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with OmniStudio, including OmniScripts, FlexCards, Data Mappers/DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures.
 



 • Hands\-on document\-generation experience, preferably including OmniStudio Document Generation and one or more of Conga, Salesforce Files, Box, or comparable platforms.
 



 • Strong Apex, SOQL/SOSL, trigger, asynchronous Apex, REST API, LWC, JavaScript, Flow, and Salesforce data\-model skills.
 



 • Experience implementing FSC or lending data involving applications, applicants, parties, relationships, financial accounts, assets, liabilities, income, collateral, documents, or servicing.
 



 • Experience building and troubleshooting API integrations, callouts, webhooks, Named Credentials, authentication, request/response mapping, and structured error handling.
 



 • Working knowledge of Salesforce security, sharing, permission sets, permission\-set groups, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Experience Cloud access, and data protection.
 



 • Experience with Git, pull requests, Salesforce CLI, source\-driven development, CI/CD, metadata deployments, and sandbox or environment management.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to bulkify code, manage order of execution, control recursion, use asynchronous patterns, and diagnose governor\-limit failures.
 



 • Ability to write meaningful automated tests and use mocks or test\-data factories appropriately.
 



 • Understanding of loan origination and fulfillment workflows and the responsibilities of sales, underwriting, closing, post\-closing, servicing, and asset\-management users.
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication, problem solving, attention to detail, ownership, and ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification; Platform Developer II preferred.
 



 • Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional or relevant FSC certification.
 



 • Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Developer or OmniStudio Consultant certification.
 



 • Salesforce JavaScript Developer I, Experience Cloud Consultant, or Platform App Builder certification.
 



 • Experience with private credit, residential investment lending, DSCR, bridge, fix\-and\-flip, construction, single\-asset bridge, build\-for\-rent, warehouse lines, or loan servicing.
 



 • Experience with Salesforce Industries Business Rules Engine, Calculation Procedures, Decision Tables, and document\-generation tooling.
 



 • Experience with Conga, Box, MuleSoft, GitHub Actions, Salesforce Git Delta, Salesforce Code Analyzer, PMD, SonarQube, or similar platforms.
 



 • Experience maintaining a large, heavily automated Salesforce org while incrementally adopting FSC standard objects and capabilities.
 



 • Experience supporting Experience Cloud portals and external\-user APIs in a regulated environment.

title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non\-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Role** 
 :
   

  

 Lead Software Engineer position to work on SFS division's SPx products based on Common software platform.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of Surfscan software.
* Be the technology evangelist for Surfscan product division
* Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future\-proof and scalable.
* Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software.
* Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements.
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan
* Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC \& Wafer customers)
* Follow KT defined software development processes
* Lead small teams to develop key features on need basis.
* In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks
* Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization’s development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solutions.
* Stay up to date with new technologies and methodologies that can enhance architecture, user experience, or development processes.
* Drive the architecture and technical design of various components within the platform.


- 

**Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 6\+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products
   

  

 (Or)
   

  

 Master's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 4\+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products
   

  

**Requirements** 
 :
   

  

* Strong in programming fundamentals, C\#, C\+\+, COM.
* Experience in Architecting systems from scratch, leading project teams.
* Diverse Experience in analysis, design, development, and unit testing
* Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
* Experience in developing enterprise applications in .NET/C\# using object\-oriented concepts.
* Proficiency in object\-oriented development principles, and relational database design patterns.
* Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments.


**Preferred Experience:**
* Experience in developing COM/DCOM using MFC/ATL
* Experience in .Net and C\#.
* Knowledge in STL, Boost Library, WinDBG and Windows Internals.
* Knowledge of CMM or other process models
* Knowledge of KT specific or general semiconductor domain


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. Within just three years of inception, we have grown into a close\-knit family of 500\+ employees, each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise include Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding \& Visualization, Finance and Supply Chain Services. We strongly aspire to venture into IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality.Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

**Key Attributes**
* Thorough knowledge of software development processes and life cycle, including conceiving, planning, execution, delivery, and scaling of large engineering projects.
* Ability to understand and communicate architectural principles, engineering best practices, coding standards, Agile methodologies, testing strategies, and team mentoring.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to engage with stakeholders, leadership, and facilitate client and internal meetings.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work efficiently, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong desire to continuously learn and adapt to emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to drive execution with minimal supervision.
* Ability to drive engineering strategy through influence, with leadership qualities that engineers respect and follow.
* Ability to innovate and lead adoption of new technologies, tools, and engineering practices.
* Ability to establish, enforce, and evolve software engineering best practices, standards, and tools across teams.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including Product, Business, Design, and external partners.
* Strong ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and ownership across teams.
* Must be able to guide teams in building Proof of Concepts (POCs) and scalable solutions across full\-stack technologies.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage engineering teams to design, develop, and deliver scalable, high\-quality software solutions aligned with business goals.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and execution plans.
* Drive architecture discussions and ensure adoption of scalable, secure, and high\-performing system designs.
* Oversee development across modern architectures such as Microservices, Micro Frontend, Responsive Design, SPA, Composable, Serverless, Event\-Driven systems, and design patterns.
* Provide technical guidance on front\-end technologies such as React Js, Angular, Vue, Redux, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES5, ES6\), Webpack, SCSS, HTML5, CSS3\.
* Guide backend and platform development using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Ensure best practices in mobile development using React Native, Flutter, Ionic, Swift/Objective\-C (iOS), and Java/Kotlin (Android).
* Oversee development of large\-scale, high\-performance user interfaces using modern UI frameworks and libraries.
* Drive enterprise integration strategies using middleware technologies, REST/SOAP services, databases, ETL, and ESB patterns.
* Provide leadership in core backend technologies such as Java, J2EE (JSP, Servlet, JDBC, JMS), Spring Framework, REST APIs, and related technologies (Python as an alternative).
* Ensure delivery of highly scalable, reliable systems through effective system design and architecture.
* Build, mentor, and scale high\-performing engineering teams with strong ownership and accountability.
* Drive best practices in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Oversee cloud infrastructure design, implementation, and optimization across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Collaborate with leadership to define engineering roadmaps, resource planning, and delivery timelines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (BE, BTech) in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience in engineering management with a strong technical background in full\-stack development.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Strong mentoring and leadership skills with the ability to build and scale engineering teams.


**Disclaimer**
 The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.

title: Senior Media Development Engineer 1
description:
Requisition Number: 20072
   

  

 Contract Type: Permanent
   

  

 Location(s):
   

  

 Chennai, IN
   

  

**Senior Engineer, Media Product Development**
**Role Description Summary**
 The incumbent will contribute to the development and testing of media software components for future media applications in the context of next generation converged satellite terrestrial content distribution networks. This includes the development and testing of media frontend applications running on next generation consumer hardware devices (like STBs, Gateways, TVs, mobile devices) and media backend applications to manage the metadata about content, users, analytics related to the platform and its operation.
   

  

  

  

 The incumbent will collaborate with internal stakeholders as well as with external partners on the overall design of media applications and will support the actual development and implementation process end\-to\-end including a strong focus on testing, debugging, validation, quality assurance up to the support of actual commercial market roll\-outs.
